nodes.label: Score SDE Paper Review (Song et al., ICLR 2021)
Forward SDE dx=f dt+g dw
nodes.rationale: Data-independent, parameter-free corruption chosen by designer; scalar g(t) keeps Gaussian transition kernels tractable for Eq. 7 training.

nodes.label: Reverse-time SDE
nodes.rationale: Score coefficient g^2 comes from diffusion covariance in Fokker-Planck; state-dependent G adds divergence term.

nodes.label: Variance Exploding (VE) SDE
nodes.rationale: Continuous limit of SMLD/NCSN noise ladder; tends to give better sample quality.

nodes.label: Variance Preserving (VP) SDE
nodes.rationale: Continuous limit of DDPM Markov chain; tends to give better likelihood.

nodes.label: Continuous-time Denoising Score Matching Objective (Eq. 7)
nodes.rationale: Regressing conditional score yields marginal score since marginal score is posterior expectation of conditional score.

nodes.label: Predictor-Corrector (PC) Sampler
nodes.rationale: Predictor moves in time with discretization error, corrector (Langevin with SNR r step) fixes current marginal; complementary under same NFE budget.

nodes.label: Probability Flow ODE
nodes.rationale: Half score coefficient exactly reproduces Fokker-Planck density evolution deterministically, enabling exact likelihood via instantaneous change of variables.

nodes.label: Conditional Generation / Inverse Problems via Conditional Score
nodes.rationale: Bayes rule splits conditional score into prior score plus likelihood gradient; imputation and colorization depend on tractable observation model.

nodes.label: Sliced Score Matching Paper Review (Song et al., UAI 2019)
Sliced Score Matching (SSM)
nodes.rationale: Randomizes only the trace term via projections instead of perturbing data (DSM), preserving exact equivalence to Fisher divergence on p_d; cost M+1 vs D+1 gradient ops.

nodes.label: Standard (Hyvarinen) Score Matching with Hessian Trace
SSM-VR (Variance-reduced SSM, Control Variate)
nodes.rationale: Replaces projected-score term with its known expectation ||s||^2 (beta=1 control variate); valid only when E[vv^T]=I.

nodes.label: Rademacher Projection Distribution
nodes.rationale: Same covariance as Gaussian but removes diagonal extra asymptotic variance term.

nodes.label: SSM as Small-shift Limit of NCE
Score Estimation for Implicit VAE / WAE Entropy Gradients
Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance Paper Review (Ho & Salimans, 2021)
Classifier-Free Guidance Extrapolation (Eq. 6)
nodes.rationale: (1+w,-w) coefficients extrapolate past the conditional prediction along the conditional-unconditional difference, which equals the implicit classifier gradient by Bayes rule; convex combination would weaken conditioning.

nodes.label: Null-condition Dropout Joint Training (p=0.1)
nodes.rationale: One network learns both conditional and unconditional scores, removing a separate classifier at the cost of two forward passes at sampling.

nodes.label: Relative Calibration of Conditional/Unconditional Outputs
nodes.rationale: Guided error = delta_c + w(delta_c - delta_u); large w amplifies calibration mismatch.

nodes.label: Latent Diffusion Models Paper Review (Rombach et al., CVPR 2022)
Latent Diffusion Model (LDM)
nodes.rationale: Moves iterative UNet denoising to a moderately compressed latent; diffusion prior chosen over autoregressive prior to avoid token-sequential prediction that would force stronger compression.

nodes.label: Downsampling Factor f Ablation (LDM-1..32)
nodes.rationale: f=4,8 balance first-stage distortion upper bound against diffusion compute; LDM-1/2 train slowly, LDM-32 caps quality.

nodes.label: Cross-attention Conditioning with Domain Encoder tau_theta
nodes.rationale: Preserves variable-length token conditions and allows per-location selection; spatially aligned conditions use concatenation instead.

nodes.label: Taming Transformers (VQGAN) Paper Review (Esser et al., CVPR 2021)
VQGAN Two-stage Pipeline
nodes.rationale: CNN tokenizer absorbs local structure and sets transformer sequence length; attention score count scales as 1/f^4.

nodes.label: Nearest-neighbor Codebook Quantization
nodes.rationale: Discrete tokens turn generation into categorical sequence modeling, avoiding mean-collapse of fixed-variance continuous regression.

nodes.label: VQ Loss with Stop-gradient Codebook/Commitment Terms
Patch Discriminator Adversarial Loss
nodes.rationale: Patch-level realism keeps first stage responsible for local statistics while transformer handles global layout.

nodes.label: Adaptive GAN Weight lambda at Last Decoder Layer
DiM: Diffusion Mamba Paper Review (Teng et al., 2024)
DiM (Diffusion Mamba) Backbone
nodes.rationale: Replaces quadratic self-attention with linear SSM; speed advantage over U-ViT appears only above ~1280x1280.

nodes.label: Four-direction Alternating Scan Patterns
nodes.rationale: Alternating directions across depth gives global receptive field; ablation shows two directions suffice vs one (17.60 FID).

nodes.label: Training-free Upsample-guidance
nodes.rationale: Applied only in early timesteps (~30%) where global structure forms; corrects high-res prediction with low-res prediction difference, no extra training.

hyperedges.label: Interchangeable samplers reusing one learned score (reverse SDE, PC, probability flow ODE)
DiM components extending 1D Mamba to 2D images (ablation set)
